# go-modern-stdlib-uuid

**Since:** Go 1.27

## Summary

Use the standard library uuid package instead of third-party libraries or custom UUID implementations when targeting Go 1.27+.

## Details

The standard uuid package covers common UUID generation and parsing without an external dependency.
Keep a third-party package only when targeting older Go versions or needing behavior outside the standard API.

## Examples

### Example 1

### Before

```go
import googleuuid "github.com/google/uuid"

id := googleuuid.New()
text := id.String()
```

### After

```go
import "uuid"

id := uuid.New()
text := id.String()
```

### Example 2

### Before 2

```go
id, err := googleuuid.Parse(raw)
if err != nil {
  return err
}
```

### After 2

```go
id, err := uuid.Parse(raw)
if err != nil {
  return err
}
```
